question: Who won the 2025 Formula 1 World Drivers' Championship, and how close was it?
text:
McLaren’s **Lando Norris** won his first Formula 1 World Drivers’ Championship in 2025, beating Max Verstappen by just **2 points**: 423 to 421. Norris’s teammate Oscar Piastri finished third with 410 points. ([formula1.com](https://www.formula1.com/en/results/2025/drivers?utm_source=openai))

The title went down to the final race in Abu Dhabi. Verstappen won the race, but Norris finished third—just enough to clinch the championship.
